payload.reason: The evidence provides specific improvements in F1 scores for speculation detection and scope resolution, indicating previously reported results.

claims.text: Substantial improvements were reported over previously reported results, with at least 0.29 F1 points on cue detection and 4.27 F1 points on scope resolution.

On the speculation detection task, gains of 0.42 F1 points on BF, 1.98 F1 points on BA, and 0.29 F1 points on SFU were achieved, while on scope resolution, gains of 8.06 F1 points on BF, 4.27 F1 points on BA, and 11.87 F1 points on SFU were reported.
